image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dark-furred wombat facing the camera. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, dark brown/grey fur. Its head is broad with small, rounded ears, small dark eyes, and a large, prominent, bare nose. The forelimbs are partially visible, appearing short and sturdy. The background consists of blurred earth, leaves, and what appears to be a concrete or stone wall.
